title: Ablate the geometry child's added trainable dimensions
hypothesis: The geometry child's advantage depends on fitting its added parameters, rather than only on its changed forward geometry.

prediction.against: gen0_cand5_a0 with all child-only parameters clamped at declared initial values
prediction.rationale: Holding child code fixed isolates trainable expressivity; five percentage points would justify allowing parameter additions, unlike the code-only intervention in D-008.

code_changes: scripts/compare_child_vs_parent.py (--research-protocol added-parameter-ablation: trainable child vs child with child-only parameters clamped at their initial values, checkpoints 0/125/250/500/750/1000, no parent arm)

falsified_by: The upper 95% paired interval is below +0.05; an interval containing zero is inconclusive about directional benefit, not evidence of improvement.

controls.note: control is the same child with its child-only parameter (approach_standoff) clamped at its initial value 0.02; the metric is already trainable minus clamped

result.notes: gen0_cand5_a0 adds one parameter to simple_damped_push, approach_standoff (initial 0.02, range [0, 0.045]). Clamped by a zero-width range so fitting cannot move it; everything else identical (fit seeds 3010/3011, checkpoints 0/125/250/500/750/1000 on probe s3012, confirmation s3013). Both arms reach 1.00 under both seeds and both select step 1000: trainable minus clamped +0.000 [0.0, 0.0], 0/0/50. The advantage over the parent (D-006) therefore comes from the child's forward geometry with the standoff fixed at 0.02, not from fitting the added dimension. Implication for D-008: the code-only restriction was not what made those geometry edits fail; their content was. 440 episodes (240 probe + 200 confirmation), 0 LLM calls.

verdicts.reasoning: Trainable minus clamped-standoff child is +0.000 [0, 0], 0/0/50; both arms score 1.00 under both fit seeds. The upper bound is below the predicted +0.05, refuting the claim that the advantage depends on fitting the added parameter. The child's win over its parent comes from its changed forward geometry with approach_standoff fixed at its declared 0.02.
verdicts.next_experiment: Treat the geometry child's gain as a fixed-geometry design fact; a hand-written variant of simple_damped_push with a fixed 0.02 standoff would reproduce it without an LLM. R-016 (adaptive search) is approved and next.
